text:
Maya (People Ops): quick heads-up — we're pushing a small handbook wording change around bereavement leave (clarity on paid days + documentation) and want to run a short compliance microtraining for managers next week. please read the draft and RSVP below: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/bereavement-draft :spiral_note_pad:

Ethan (ENG): thanks — quick q: is this changing eligibility or just the wording?

Maya (People Ops): wording & examples only. eligibility thresholds stay the same. main change: clearer examples for immediate family vs extended, and new doc checklist for payroll/benefits.

Priya (People Ops): two manager drop-in sessions planned: Tue 10:00-10:45 PT and Thu 16:00-16:45 PT. pick one and add your headcount in the sign-off sheet.

Luca (Manager): adding headcount now. is there an accommodation flow for partial-day adjustments? some teams use flexible time for funeral attendance.

Maya (People Ops): good call. we'll add an 'partial-day' guidance paragraph and an example for flexible time. not a policy change, just official guidance.

Sam (HR): payroll needs the documentation checklist in CSV-friendly columns. adding a tiny snippet here so we all align:

```
employee_id, employee_name, event_type, start_date, end_date, docs_submitted (Y/N), docs_type, manager_signed (Y/N)
```

people-ops-bot: automated reminder set — RSVP sheet closes 48h before first session.

Ethan (ENG): can we make the manager microtraining optional for ICs who are acting managers for a week? or should they be required?

Priya (People Ops): acting managers should attend if they approve leave. we can offer the recorded session but require sign-off by their org manager.

Luca (Manager): can L&D include a 5-min FAQ card I can drop into our weekly manager sync? saves time.

Maya (People Ops): yes — Priya, can you coordinate a 1-slide FAQ and the recording link post-session?

Priya (People Ops): on it. I'll post the slide and a 60s TL;DR clip to #manager-briefs after the Tue session.

Sam (HR): payroll note — to avoid manual exceptions, please instruct managers to attach docs in the HR portal under 'Time-Off Docs' tag. we'll auto-ingest CSV columns if present.

Ethan (ENG): registered for Tue. adding a quick comment in the sheet: 12 engineers, 2 acting managers.

Maya (People Ops): perfect — last ask: managers, update the RSVP sheet with names and headcounts by EOD Mon so payroll and L&D can prep. will post final handbook patch after sessions. thanks :heart:

people-ops-bot: RSVP sheet link: https://sheets.redwood.ai/s/bereavement-rsvp — last update 2026-03-22 19:07:12 UTC
